# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This project is maintained on a best-effort basis. Security fixes are
considered for the current 1.0.x line on `master`.

| Version | Security updates |
| --- | --- |
| 1.0.x (`master`) | Best-effort |
| Earlier releases | Not actively supported |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities **privately** through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bpangburn/jdbcrowsetimpl/security/advisories/new).
Avoid disclosing exploit details through public issues.

Provide the affected version/commit, impact, and reproduction steps if possible.
We aim to acknowledge reports within seven days where feasible, but cannot
guarantee a fixed response or release schedule. Confirmed issues may be
addressed through an update and a coordinated security advisory.
